sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 11411 of 2023
Applicant :- Ram Vilas Alias Ram Vikas And Another
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lucknow And

Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Verma,Rohit Shankar

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Ashok Kumar Verma, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rishikesh Verma,
learned A.G.A. appearing on behalf of the State.
2.

By means of the instant application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant no. 1, who is an accused in the F.I.R No. 661/2019 dated 17.12.2019 lodged in P.S. Bangarmau, District Unnao,
alleging commission of offences under Sections 363 and 366 I.P.C and the applicant no.2 who is alleged to have been enticed away by the applicant no.1 in the said F.I.R, have approached this court seeking quashing of the charge sheet and the criminal proceedings on the ground that there was a discrepancy regarding the age of the applicant no.2 - the victim of the alleged offences in her educational certificates and, therefore, her radiological examination was conducted to ascertain her age, from which it came to light that on the date of the incident, the alleged victim- applicant no. 2 was major on the date of the incident.
3. The applicant no. 2 has filed a supplementary affidavit stating her age to be 21 years and she has prayed for closure of the proceedings of Session Trial No. 362/2020 in the Court of Additional Ram Vilas Alias Ram Vikas And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54255726/
1 Session Judge, Court no. 12, District Unnao and initiated on the basis of F.I.R No. 661/2019.
4.

entities.text: Additional Ram Vilas Alias Ram Vikas And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant no. 1 and the applicant no. 2 are present in person before the court, who are duly identified by Sri Ashok Kumar Verma, the learned counsel for the applicants and both of them have stated that they have married each other on 11.12.2019, and the applicant no. 2 has delivered a son on 24.12.2021.

5. From the aforesaid facts, it appears that continuance of criminal proceedings will yield no purpose, except to give rise an apprehension of disruption of each other matrimonial life of the applicant no. 2- the alleged victim of the offence.

6. Keeping in view th aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, the application is allowed and the charge sheet dated 18.06.2020 along with the entire proceedings of the case in Session Trial No.
362/2020 arising out of Case Crime No. 661/2019, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, Police Station Bangarmau, District Unnao are hereby quashed.
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Preeti.
